points.description: Setup: data labelled with two classes (+/- , e.g. +1/-1) and weights initialised (randomly or otherwise).
Update rule: for a misclassified point (e.g. <w,x> <= 0 after sign-adjusting by label, or y*<w,x> <= 0), update w = w + eta*y*x (simplified: Δw = eta*x). Equivalent correct forms accepted.
points.partial_credit: 0.5 if update is given but without the condition for misclassification, or condition given without correct update.

points.description: Loop over all data points/epochs repeatedly until no more misclassifications / weights stop changing (convergence guaranteed since data is linearly separable).
